title: Optus Networks Pty Limited - completed acquisition of spectrum licences from Austar United Communications Limited

body_sections.Summary: Optus acquired certain spectrum licences from Austar
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not consider it necessary to define the relevant markets for the purposes of this competition analysis.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition as it would facilitate new entry to broadband services provision in certain regional markets.
